answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service rather than accumulated once and hoarded. Reciprocity-weighted transitive links feed the EigenTrust matrix factorization; a freshly spawned Sybil has almost no trusted path mass and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality, far below consensus thresholds. Like a vine reaching for the zenith, credibility grows only across a long horizon of corroborated behavior.
